scope: NHSW styling of current preview only, not full Refactor gate
checks: Local official stylesheet served; no external runtime requests
Visible labels remain associated with native controls
Primary button renders official NHSW blue
Keyboard Shift+Tab reaches select with visible focus styling
Executed AA contrast measurements for current text, hints, controls, buttons, hover/focus, saved values and generic error
Preview has no horizontal overflow at 320, 768 and 1280 pixels

contrast.method: Chromium computed sRGB colours, alpha-composited over rendered ancestor backgrounds; WCAG relative luminance. No colour rounding before threshold comparison.
contrast.criteria: 1.4.3: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text (24px or 18.667px bold). 1.4.11: 3:1 control boundaries and contrasting focus indicator portions. Visible keyboard focus also checked separately (2.4.7). Not a full WCAG audit or AAA 2.4.13 claim.
